overview: This single-page file consists of a list-of-papers or docket sheet for State Department decimal file 894C.50 on economic matters in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records one item, apparently an August 23 communication from Dairen to the Embassy concerning a report on the Manchu-Japanese Economic Conference held at Dairen from August 15 to 17, and notes related filing references for general economic affairs and Manchuria. The underlying report or telegram is not present in the supplied file text.

subfiles.summary: This docket sheet identifies one paper in the file: a communication from Dairen to the Embassy, associated with Vincent. The indexed paper reported on the Manchu-Japanese Economic Conference, convened at Dairen on August 15 and concluded on August 17. Filing annotations direct attention to related decimal-file categories 894.50 and 897.50 for Manchuria, but the substantive report itself is absent from the supplied pages.

interest: The page is useful primarily as archival evidence for a missing or separately filed report on a short Manchu-Japanese economic conference in Dairen. Its filing annotations reveal how State Department officials linked economic conditions in the Kwantung Leased Territory to broader Manchurian affairs. The parenthetical reference to Vincent may also help identify the responsible diplomatic or departmental official when compared with adjacent files.
